title: १० अर्बबढी हिनामिना र ठगीका आरोपी बराह सहकारीका अध्यक्ष शिव लामिछाने पक्राउ
content:
No ads found for this position विराटनगर । बचतकर्ताको रकम हिनामिना गरेर फरार भएका धरान स्थित बराह बचत तथा ऋण सहकारी संस्थाका अध्यक्ष शिवकुमार लामिछाने ( विश्वकर्मा) पक्राउ परेका छन् । उनलाई सीआईबीको टोलीले पक्राउ गरेको सुनसरीका प्रहरी प्रमुख एसपी पुष्पराज मल्लले पुष्टि गरे । यसअघि गृहमन्त्री सुधन गुरुङले समेत सामाजिक सञ्जालमा स्टाटस लेख्दै पूर्वलाई न्याय भएको बताएका छ । गुरुङले बराह सहकारीका मुख्य योजनाकार पक्राउ परेको लेखेका छन् । उनले एक वर्षअघि धरानमा सेभ घोपा अभियान सञ्चालनको क्रममा बीपी कोइराला स्वास्थ्य विज्ञान प्रतिष्ठानको बेथिति विरुद्ध बोल्दा सुनिएका पूर्वका बचतकर्ताहरूको त्यो पीडाले आफूलाई सधैँ झकझकाइरहेको बताएका छन् । उनले अभियन्ता हुँदा वा जेनजी आन्दोलन पश्चातका प्रयासहरूमा तत्काल केही गर्न नसके पनि, गृहमन्त्रीको जिम्मेवारी सम्हालेकै दिनदेखि डे वानबाटै पूर्वका नागरिकको पीडालाई न्याय दिन खोजीलाई तीव्र पारिएको उल्लेख गरे । गुरुङले ५ अर्ब ८८ करोडभन्दा बढीको बिगो हिनामिनाका मुख्य योजनाकारलाई कानुनी कठघरामा उभ्याउन सफल भएका र क्रमबद्ध रूपमा अब बाँकी दोषीहरूलाई खोजी तथा कारबाहीको प्रक्रिया तीव्र बनाउने बताएका छन् । बराह बचत तथा ऋण सहकारी संस्थाका सञ्चालकले धरान सहित देशभरका चार हजार ७७२ जना भन्दा बढीको १० अर्ब ७३ करोड भन्दा बढी रुपैयाँ हिनामिना गरेको आरोप लाग्दै आएको छ । बचतकर्ताको रकम फिर्ता गर्न नसकेपछि लामिछाने फरार थिए । संस्थाका अध्यक्ष सहित सञ्चालक फरार भएपछि रकम फिर्ताको माग राख्दै पीडितहरूले उजुरी दिएका थिए । उजुरीपछि सहकारीको नाममा रकम हिनामिना तथा अपचलन गरेको जाहेरी परेपछि जिल्ला प्रहरी कार्यालय सुनसरीले प्रहरी निरीक्षक दिनेश अधिकारीको नेतृत्वमा अनुसन्धान गरेको थियो। प्रहरी निरीक्षक अधिकारीको अनुसन्धान प्रतिवेदनले कुल १० अर्ब ७३ करोड ४३ लाख ४७ हजार९१३ रुपैयाँ रकम हिनामिना तथा अपचलन गरी ठगी भएको निष्कर्ष निकालेको छ। सहकारीका मुख्य सञ्चालक मानबहादुर विश्वकर्मा, गंगा कालिकोटेलगायतका व्यक्ति भने अझै फरार छन्। बचतकर्ताको रकममध्ये सबैभन्दा हिनामिना शिवकुमार लामिछानेले गरेको प्रहरीको अभियोग पत्रमा उल्लेख छ। जसमा शिवकुमारले मात्र २ अर्ब ७१ करोड ३१ लख ६० हजार २४ रुपैयाँ हिनामिना गरेको अभियोग पत्रमा उल्लेख छ । Biratnagar. Shiva Kumar Lamichhane (Bishwokarma), the chairman of Barah Savings and Loan Cooperative Society in Dharan, who had absconded after embezzling the money of savers, has been arrested. Sunsari Police Chief SP Pushparaj Malla confirmed that he was arrested by a CIB team. Earlier, Home Minister Sudan Gurung had also written a status on social media saying that justice has been served to the former. Home Minister Gurung has said that the CIB has arrested the chief planner of Barah Cooperative, Shiva Kumar Bishwakarma (Lamichhane). He claims that the pain of former savers, who were heard speaking against the poor condition of the BP Koirala Institute of Health Sciences during the Save Ghopa campaign in Dharan a year ago, still haunts him. He claimed that even though he was unable to do anything immediately during his time as an activist or in the efforts after the Genji Movement, the search for justice for the suffering of the citizens of the East has been intensified since the day he assumed the responsibility of Home Minister. He has claimed that he has succeeded in bringing the main mastermind of the embezzlement of over Rs 5.88 billion to justice and will now gradually intensify the process of searching for and prosecuting the remaining culprits. The director of Barah Savings and Credit Cooperative Society is accused of embezzling more than Rs 10.73 billion from more than 4,772 people across the country, including Dharan. Lamichhane was absconding after failing to return the savings. He said that Lamichhane was arrested from Sunsari. After the chairman and the directors of the organization absconded, the victims had filed a complaint demanding the return of the money. After the complaint was filed, the District Police Office, Sunsari, under the leadership of Police Inspector Dinesh Adhikari, conducted an investigation after a complaint was received alleging that money had been embezzled and misappropriated in the name of the cooperative. The investigation report of the police inspector has concluded that a total of Rs 10.73 billion 43 lakh 47 thousand 913 was embezzled and misappropriated. The main directors of the cooperative, Man Bahadur Bishwakarma, Ganga Kalikote and others are still absconding. The police charge sheet mentions that Shiva Kumar Lamichhane embezzled the most of the depositors' money. The charge sheet mentions that Shiva Kumar alone embezzled Rs 2.71 billion 31 lakh 60 thousand 24.

Shiva Kumar Lamichhane (Bishwokarma), the chairman of Barah Savings and Loan Cooperative Society in Dharan, who had absconded after embezzling the money of savers, has been arrested. Sunsari Police Chief SP Pushparaj Malla confirmed that he was arrested by a CIB team. Earlier, Home Minister Sudan Gurung had also written a status on social media saying that justice has been served to the former. Home Minister Gurung has said that the CIB has arrested the chief planner of Barah Cooperative, Shiva Kumar Bishwakarma (Lamichhane). He claims that the pain of former savers, who were heard speaking against the poor condition of the BP Koirala Institute of Health Sciences during the Save Ghopa campaign in Dharan a year ago, still haunts him. He claimed that even though he was unable to do anything immediately during his time as an activist or in the efforts after the Genji Movement, the search for justice for the suffering of the citizens of the East has been intensified since the day he assumed the responsibility of Home Minister. He has claimed that he has succeeded in bringing the main mastermind of the embezzlement of over Rs 5.88 billion to justice and will now gradually intensify the process of searching for and prosecuting the remaining culprits. The director of Barah Savings and Credit Cooperative Society is accused of embezzling more than Rs 10.73 billion from more than 4,772 people across the country, including Dharan. Lamichhane was absconding after failing to return the savings. He said that Lamichhane was arrested from Sunsari. After the chairman and the directors of the organization absconded, the victims had filed a complaint demanding the return of the money. After the complaint was filed, the District Police Office, Sunsari, under the leadership of Police Inspector Dinesh Adhikari, conducted an investigation after a complaint was received alleging that money had been embezzled and misappropriated in the name of the cooperative. The investigation report of the police inspector has concluded that a total of Rs 10.73 billion 43 lakh 47 thousand 913 was embezzled and misappropriated. The main directors of the cooperative, Man Bahadur Bishwakarma, Ganga Kalikote and others are still absconding. The police charge sheet mentions that Shiva Kumar Lamichhane embezzled the most of the depositors' money. The charge sheet mentions that Shiva Kumar alone embezzled Rs 2.71 billion 31 lakh 60 thousand 24.

उनले अभियन्ता हुँदा वा जेनजी आन्दोलन पश्चातका प्रयासहरूमा तत्काल केही गर्न नसके पनि, गृहमन्त्रीको जिम्मेवारी सम्हालेकै दिनदेखि डे वानबाटै पूर्वका नागरिकको पीडालाई न्याय दिन खोजीलाई तीव्र पारिएको उल्लेख गरे ।

गुरुङले ५ अर्ब ८८ करोडभन्दा बढीको बिगो हिनामिनाका मुख्य योजनाकारलाई कानुनी कठघरामा उभ्याउन सफल भएका र क्रमबद्ध रूपमा अब बाँकी दोषीहरूलाई खोजी तथा कारबाहीको प्रक्रिया तीव्र बनाउने बताएका छन् ।

बराह बचत तथा ऋण सहकारी संस्थाका सञ्चालकले धरान सहित देशभरका चार हजार ७७२ जना भन्दा बढीको १० अर्ब ७३ करोड भन्दा बढी रुपैयाँ हिनामिना गरेको आरोप लाग्दै आएको छ । बचतकर्ताको रकम फिर्ता गर्न नसकेपछि लामिछाने फरार थिए ।

संस्थाका अध्यक्ष सहित सञ्चालक फरार भएपछि रकम फिर्ताको माग राख्दै पीडितहरूले उजुरी दिएका थिए । उजुरीपछि सहकारीको नाममा रकम हिनामिना तथा अपचलन गरेको जाहेरी परेपछि जिल्ला प्रहरी कार्यालय सुनसरीले प्रहरी निरीक्षक दिनेश अधिकारीको नेतृत्वमा अनुसन्धान गरेको थियो।

प्रहरी निरीक्षक अधिकारीको अनुसन्धान प्रतिवेदनले कुल १० अर्ब ७३ करोड ४३ लाख ४७ हजार९१३ रुपैयाँ रकम हिनामिना तथा अपचलन गरी ठगी भएको निष्कर्ष निकालेको छ। सहकारीका मुख्य सञ्चालक मानबहादुर विश्वकर्मा, गंगा कालिकोटेलगायतका व्यक्ति भने अझै फरार छन्।

बचतकर्ताको रकममध्ये सबैभन्दा हिनामिना शिवकुमार लामिछानेले गरेको प्रहरीको अभियोग पत्रमा उल्लेख छ। जसमा शिवकुमारले मात्र २ अर्ब ७१ करोड ३१ लख ६० हजार २४ रुपैयाँ हिनामिना गरेको अभियोग पत्रमा उल्लेख छ ।

Biratnagar. Shiva Kumar Lamichhane (Bishwokarma), the chairman of Barah Savings and Loan Cooperative Society in Dharan, who had absconded after embezzling the money of savers, has been arrested. Sunsari Police Chief SP Pushparaj Malla confirmed that he was arrested by a CIB team. Earlier, Home Minister Sudan Gurung had also written a status on social media saying that justice has been served to the former. Home Minister Gurung has said that the CIB has arrested the chief planner of Barah Cooperative, Shiva Kumar Bishwakarma (Lamichhane). He claims that the pain of former savers, who were heard speaking against the poor condition of the BP Koirala Institute of Health Sciences during the Save Ghopa campaign in Dharan a year ago, still haunts him. He claimed that even though he was unable to do anything immediately during his time as an activist or in the efforts after the Genji Movement, the search for justice for the suffering of the citizens of the East has been intensified since the day he assumed the responsibility of Home Minister. He has claimed that he has succeeded in bringing the main mastermind of the embezzlement of over Rs 5.88 billion to justice and will now gradually intensify the process of searching for and prosecuting the remaining culprits. The director of Barah Savings and Credit Cooperative Society is accused of embezzling more than Rs 10.73 billion from more than 4,772 people across the country, including Dharan. Lamichhane was absconding after failing to return the savings. He said that Lamichhane was arrested from Sunsari. After the chairman and the directors of the organization absconded, the victims had filed a complaint demanding the return of the money. After the complaint was filed, the District Police Office, Sunsari, under the leadership of Police Inspector Dinesh Adhikari, conducted an investigation after a complaint was received alleging that money had been embezzled and misappropriated in the name of the cooperative. The investigation report of the police inspector has concluded that a total of Rs 10.73 billion 43 lakh 47 thousand 913 was embezzled and misappropriated. The main directors of the cooperative, Man Bahadur Bishwakarma, Ganga Kalikote and others are still absconding. The police charge sheet mentions that Shiva Kumar Lamichhane embezzled the most of the depositors' money. The charge sheet mentions that Shiva Kumar alone embezzled Rs 2.71 billion 31 lakh 60 thousand 24.
